title: self_movement
summary: Benilla's self-mover wire: the MSG_MOVE_* stream, spline-done ack, worldport ack, teleport ack (full guid), the four forced-speed-change acks, and the granted move-mode ack family (root/unroot/water-walk/feather-fall/hover). MSUI implements the MSG_MOVE_* transition stream with correct MovementInfo tails (LocalMovementSender + MovementInfo.Write), MSG_MOVE_TELEPORT_ACK receive+full-guid reply, CMSG_MOVE_WORLDPORT_ACK, and the root/unroot ack pair, but none of the speed-change or remaining mode acks and no spline-done.

openItems.text: CMSG_MOVE_SPLINE_DONE never sent - a server-authored spline addressed to the player (taxi end, charge, knockback) is never acked, so vmangos SplineDonePending relocation/rebroadcast is left to its timeout fallback

SMSG_FORCE_RUN/RUN_BACK/SWIM/WALK_SPEED_CHANGE (and turn-rate) have no handler and CMSG_FORCE_*_SPEED_CHANGE_ACK is never sent - Benilla documents the ack as mandatory (server force-resolves after ~4 s and flags anticheat)
Granted move-mode acks CMSG_MOVE_WATER_WALK_ACK / CMSG_MOVE_FEATHER_FALL_ACK / CMSG_MOVE_HOVER_ACK missing (only root/unroot is acked); un-acked, the server never applies the mode
